description: This file defines a mock class 'DispatcherMock' for the 'WPEFramework::PluginHost::ILocalDispatcher' interface, used for unit testing purposes. It includes mock methods for dispatcher operations such as AddRef, Release, Activate, Deactivate, Invoke, and others.

classes.name: DispatcherMock
classes.description: A mock class implementing the ILocalDispatcher interface for testing, providing mocked methods for dispatcher behaviors.
